files.content: # Mantis — agent guide Mantis is a dark, cinematic design system (shadcn registry on Base UI, Tailwind v4). Build every screen from the components and token utilities below. **Prefer this file over your memory of shadcn:** variants, sizes and colors differ. ## Rules The Mantis repo fails its build on the ones marked ⛔; hold your code to the same bar. 1. ⛔ **Colors come from tokens only.** No hex/rgb, no `bg-[#…]`, no Tailwind palette (`text-white`, `bg-zinc-900`). Use the utilities under *Tokens*. Motion and blur too: `duration-(--duration-normal)`, `backdrop-blur-glass`, never `duration-200` or `backdrop-blur-md`. 2. ⛔ **No arbitrary pixels** (`w-[13px]`) outside `components/ui`. Use the spacing scale (`w-105` = 420px) or a component size prop. 3. ⛔ **Base UI, not Radix.** Compose with `render`: `}>Open`. Never `asChild`. A link that looks like a button is a real `` styled with `buttonVariants`: `` (Button with `render={}` is announced as a button). 4. ⛔ **Icons:** `` from `@/components/ui/icon` only — never lucide-react. Names are listed under *Icons*. 5. **Lime (`brand`) marks the one main call to action on a screen:** generate, sign up, buy or upgrade a plan, the main marketing call to action, or the main action of a focused flow (upload, download, follow). Everyday confirm and save actions in forms, settings and dialogs (Save, Continue, Invite) use the white `default` button. One lime action and one filled button per view, card or dialog (a signed-out top bar's Sign up may repeat the page's own ask). No large lime areas besides the announcement bar and the marketing footer. 6. **Pink and blue are for offers, not buying:** `sale`, `badge-hot`, `badge-value` and `commerce-pink` mark sales, discounts and best-value tags. Plans are bought with the lime `brand` button, not `commerce-blue`. 7. **Dark only.** There is no light mode: never add a theme toggle or light-mode styles. Base styles already are the dark theme, so new code needs no `dark:` variants. 8. **Compose before you build.** Check *Blocks* for a ready-made pattern or page first (`npx shadcn@latest add @mantis/`), then compose from *Components*. Do not restyle the installed files in `components/ui`; if nothing fits, ask the owner rather than forking a primitive. 9. **Content is your own.** Write real copy for the product (never lorem ipsum); images are `https://picsum.photos/seed///` with descriptive `alt`. 10. **Accessible by default.** Icon-only buttons get `aria-label`; every field gets a visible label; text meets 4.5:1 (the tokens already do — do not lower opacity on text). ## Components Import from `@/components/ui/`. Each entry: **name** exports · Mantis-specific props (`=` lists the allowed values) · what it is for · alternatives to weigh · rule ids. Full guide with do/don't: `https://mantisdesignsystem.com/usage/.md`. - **accordion** Accordion, AccordionContent, AccordionItem, AccordionTrigger · Stacked sections that open one at a time, such as the steps of a character builder or a list of advanced settings. · instead: tabs · rules: scannable-triggers - **alert-dialog** AlertDialog, AlertDialogAction, AlertDialogCancel, AlertDialogContent, AlertDialogDescription, AlertDialogFooter, AlertDialogHeader, AlertDialogMedia, AlertDialogOverlay, AlertDialogPortal, AlertDialogTitle, AlertDialogTrigger · AlertDialogAction: same props as Button · AlertDialogCancel: same props as Button · AlertDialogContent(size=sm|default) · A blocking confirmation for an action that cannot be undone, such as deleting a generation or cancelling a plan. · instead: dialog, sonner · rules: name-the-consequence, safe-choice-first - **avatar** Avatar, AvatarBadge, AvatarFallback, AvatarGroup, AvatarGroupCount, AvatarImage · Avatar(size=default|xs|sm|lg) · A round picture or initials that stands for a person, such as the account button, a post author or a collaborator. · instead: badge · rules: always-a-fallback, name-nearby - **badge** Badge · Badge(variant=new|neutral|tag|sale|hot|value|gold|outline|destructive) · A short label that marks something as new, discounted, featured or counted, set beside the thing it describes. · instead: button, sonner · rules: one-badge-per-item, commerce-badges-for-commerce, short-labels - **button** Button · Button(variant=default|brand|brand-tint|secondary|glass|soft|outline|ghost|destructive|commerce-pink|commerce-blue|link, depth=flat|raised|glossy, size=default|2xs|xs|sm|lg|xl|cta|2xl|3xl|icon-xs|icon-sm|icon|icon-lg) · Runs an action in place: saving a project, inviting a collaborator, confirming a delete, or opening a dialog. · instead: A link (``), dropdown-menu, tabs · rules: lime-marks-the-main-action, one-primary-action, label-with-a-verb, destructive-means-irreversible, name-icon-only-buttons - **card** Card, CardAction, CardContent, CardDescription, CardFooter, CardHeader, CardTitle · Card(size=default|sm, variant=default|glass|outlined|media) · Holds the content and actions for one subject, such as a generation, a project or a credit balance, on a single bordered surface. · instead: table, dialog · rules: no-nested-cards, actions-in-footer, describe-images - **checkbox** Checkbox · Checkbox(variant=brand|primary, size=xs|sm|md|lg) · Lets someone pick any number of independent options, such as which sessions to sign out or which formats to export. · instead: switch, radio-group · rules: label-every-box, brand-for-selection - **combobox** Combobox, ComboboxChip, ComboboxChips, ComboboxChipsInput, ComboboxCollection, ComboboxContent, ComboboxEmpty, ComboboxGroup, ComboboxInput, ComboboxItem, ComboboxLabel, ComboboxList, ComboboxSeparator, ComboboxTrigger, ComboboxValue · ComboboxInput(showTrigger: boolean, showClear: boolean) · ComboboxChip(showRemove: boolean) · A searchable picker: type to filter a long list, then choose one item, such as a model, a preset or a collaborator. · instead: select, dropdown-menu · rules: helpful-empty-result - **dialog** Dialog, DialogClose, DialogContent, DialogDescription, DialogFooter, DialogHeader, DialogOverlay, DialogPortal, DialogTitle, DialogTrigger · DialogContent(showCloseButton: boolean) · DialogFooter(showCloseButton: boolean) · A modal window that pauses the page for one short task or decision, such as deleting a generation or renaming a project. · instead: A new page, sonner, dropdown-menu · rules: one-decision-per-dialog, always-title-and-description, leaving-is-safe - **dropdown-menu** DropdownMenu, DropdownMenuCheckboxItem, DropdownMenuContent, DropdownMenuGroup, DropdownMenuItem, DropdownMenuLabel, DropdownMenuPortal, DropdownMenuRadioGroup, DropdownMenuRadioItem, DropdownMenuSeparator, DropdownMenuShortcut, DropdownMenuSub, DropdownMenuSubContent, DropdownMenuSubTrigger, DropdownMenuTrigger · DropdownMenuLabel(inset: boolean) · DropdownMenuItem(inset: boolean, variant=default|destructive) · DropdownMenuCheckboxItem(inset: boolean) · DropdownMenuRadioItem(inset: boolean) · DropdownMenuSubTrigger(inset: boolean) · A list of actions or options that opens from a button, keeping secondary choices tucked away until someone asks for them. · instead: button, A select, tabs · rules: trigger-shows-a-menu, destructive-last, short-item-labels - **field** Field, FieldContent, FieldDescription, FieldError, FieldGroup, FieldLabel, FieldLegend, FieldSeparator, FieldSet, FieldTitle · Field(orientation=vertical|horizontal|responsive) · FieldError(errors: ({ message?: string | undefined; } | undefined)[]) · FieldLegend(variant=label|legend) · Wraps a form control with its label, hint and error message, laid out the way the reference's profile and settings forms are. · instead: input · rules: label-above, errors-say-how-to-fix - **heading** Heading, HeadingAccent · Heading(level=hero|section|sub|label|title|title-sm) · Page and section headings: the signature uppercase grotesk display levels (hero, section, sub, label) and plain Inter titles for dialogs and panels. · instead: badge · rules: one-lime-word, display-for-pages-titles-for-panels, keep-heading-order - **icon** Icon, IconName, IconProps · Icon(label: string) · Draws a Material Symbols icon by name, sized to the text around it and painted in its color. · instead: An image (``), Text alone · rules: inherit-size-and-color, label-only-when-alone, shipped-names-only - **icon-tile** IconTile · IconTile(color=blue|purple|pink|orange|mint|brown|neutral, size=sm|md|lg) · A small colored rounded square behind an icon that gives each nav, menu or settings entry a recognizable color, from the reference's palette pairs. · instead: icon, avatar · rules: tile-beside-label, stable-colors - **input** Input · Input(inputSize=default|lg) · A single-line text field for short typed answers: project names, seeds, collaborator emails, search terms. · instead: A textarea, A select or radio group, form · rules: always-a-visible-label, size-to-the-answer, errors-say-how-to-fix - **input-group** InputGroup, InputGroupAddon, InputGroupButton, InputGroupInput, InputGroupText, InputGroupTextarea · InputGroupAddon(align=inline-start|inline-end|block-start|block-end) · InputGroupButton(variant=as Button, depth=as Button, size=xs|sm|icon-xs|icon-sm, type=button|submit|reset) · An input with icons or buttons inside its frame, such as a search field with a leading magnifier or a link field with a Copy button. · instead: input · rules: one-inline-action - **kbd** Kbd, KbdGroup · Shows a keyboard key or shortcut, such as ⌘K beside the search pill or Esc in a dialog footer. · instead: badge · rules: one-key-per-kbd - **label** Label - **media-tile** MediaTile, MediaTileProps · MediaTile(src: string, alt: string, loading=lazy|eager, aspect: number | "video" | "auto" | "landscape" | "square" | "portrait", radius=none|lg|xl|2xl, inset=lg|xs|sm|md, title: ReactNode, description: ReactNode, badge: ReactNode, detail: ReactNode, selected: boolean, indicator: ReactNode, actions: ReactNode, actionsAlign=start|end, actionsVisible: boolean, footer: ReactNode, href: string, onClick: MouseEventHandler, label: string) · An image or video filling a rounded frame, for pickers, galleries, feeds and libraries. · instead: card, avatar, skeleton · rules: media-first, lime-means-selected, one-corner-badge, actions-on-hover - **pagination** Pagination, PaginationProps · Pagination(page: number, pageCount: number, onPageChange: (page: number) => void, pageSize: number, pageSizes: number[], onPageSizeChange: (size: number) => void) · The compact pager under a table: an optional rows-per-page picker, "Page X of Y" and previous and next buttons. · instead: A Load more button, tabs · rules: say-where-you-are, reset-on-resize, under-the-table - **popover** Popover, PopoverContent, PopoverDescription, PopoverHeader, PopoverTitle, PopoverTrigger · A small floating panel anchored to a control, for a few related choices or a short form without leaving the page. · instead: dropdown-menu, dialog, tooltip · rules: stay-small, anchor-to-trigger - **progress** Progress, ProgressIndicator, ProgressLabel, ProgressTrack, ProgressValue · A thin lime bar on a faint track that shows how much of something is used or done, such as credits left this month. · instead: skeleton · rules: state-the-numbers - **radio-group** RadioGroup, RadioGroupCard, RadioGroupItem · Lets someone choose exactly one option from a short list, either as small radios or as whole selectable cards. · instead: toggle-group, select, checkbox · rules: cards-for-explained-choices, preselect-a-safe-default - **select** Select, SelectContent, SelectGroup, SelectItem, SelectLabel, SelectScrollDownButton, SelectScrollUpButton, SelectSeparator, SelectTrigger, SelectValue · SelectTrigger(size=default|sm) · A composer-style chip that opens a menu to pick one value, such as the aspect ratio or quality of a generation. · instead: toggle-group, dropdown-menu · rules: show-current-value, order-options-predictably - **separator** Separator · A 1px white 8% line that divides groups inside one surface, such as sections of a menu or a settings card. · instead: card · rules: space-before-lines - **sheet** Sheet, SheetClose, SheetContent, SheetDescription, SheetFooter, SheetHeader, SheetTitle, SheetTrigger · SheetContent(side=top|right|bottom|left, showCloseButton: boolean) · A panel that slides in from an edge to show details or settings next to the page, such as a generation inspector or project settings. · instead: dialog, popover · rules: right-for-details, title-what-it-shows - **skeleton** Skeleton · A dark placeholder block with a slow shimmer that holds the shape of content while it loads, such as thumbnails in the asset picker. · instead: progress · rules: match-the-real-shape, not-for-long-waits - **slider** Slider · Adjusts a value along a range by dragging a small white thumb, such as the zoom level of a generation grid. · instead: toggle-group, input · rules: show-the-ends, live-preview - **sonner** Toaster · Brief toast notifications that confirm an action finished, or report a problem, without pulling the user away from the canvas. · instead: dialog, Text next to the field · rules: mount-one-toaster, say-what-happened, never-the-only-record, undo-over-confirm - **spinner** Spinner · Spinner(label: string) · A small spinning ring that shows something is working, such as a button while it upscales or a tile while it queues. · instead: progress, skeleton · rules: spinner-with-words - **stepper** Stepper · Stepper(value: number, defaultValue: number, min: number, max: number, onValueChange: (value: number) => void, label: string) · The composer's "− 1/4 +" control for small whole-number settings, such as how many images to generate at once. · instead: slider, toggle-group · rules: show-the-maximum - **switch** Switch · Switch(size=default|lg) · Turns one setting on or off immediately, such as sound on a clip or making a project public. · instead: checkbox, toggle-group · rules: label-the-setting, takes-effect-now - **table** Table, TableBody, TableCaption, TableCell, TableFooter, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow · Lays records out in rows and columns so people can scan, compare and act on many items that share the same fields. · instead: card, A plain list · rules: align-numbers-right, status-in-words, name-the-table - **tabs** Tabs, TabsContent, TabsList, TabsTrigger · TabsList(variant=default|line|pill) · Switches between a few related views of one subject without leaving the page, such as a project's overview, activity and settings. · instead: A multi-step flow, dropdown-menu, A radio group · rules: tabs-are-peers, keep-labels-short, remember-the-tab - **textarea** Textarea · Textarea(variant=field|prompt|prompt-lg) · A multi-line text field: a filled `field` for forms, and borderless `prompt` and `prompt-lg` for writing generation prompts. · instead: input · rules: prompt-inside-composer, placeholder-is-an-example - **toggle** Toggle · Toggle(variant=segment|outline|ghost, size=sm|default|lg) · A single pressable button that stays pressed until pressed again, styled like one segment of a toggle group. · instead: toggle-group, switch · rules: icon-needs-a-name - **toggle-group** ToggleGroup, ToggleGroupItem · ToggleGroup(variant=outline|ghost|segment, size=default|sm|lg, spacing: number) · ToggleGroupItem(variant=outline|ghost|segment, size=default|sm|lg) · A compact row of options where the chosen one is highlighted: a white segment (`segment`) or a lime-outlined tile (`outline`). · instead: tabs, radio-group, select · rules: few-short-options, single-for-exclusive - **tooltip** Tooltip, TooltipContent, TooltipProvider, TooltipTrigger · A small dark label that names an icon-only control when someone hovers or focuses it. · instead: popover, badge · rules: name-the-control, not-the-only-label ## Blocks Ready-made patterns: `npx shadcn@latest add @mantis/` installs one into `components/.tsx`. Reuse or extend one before composing from scratch; full guide at `https://mantisdesignsystem.com/usage/.md`. - `hello-card` (content) — You are verifying a fresh install of this design system renders correctly. - `media-grid` (data-display, content) — You are building an explore or community page that shows many people's images at their natural… - `lightbox-inspector` (data-display, productivity) — Someone opens one generation from a feed or gallery to see it large, read its prompt and… - `how-it-works` (marketing, content) — You are explaining a tool or workflow to first-time visitors in three ordered steps on a… - `feed-post` (content, messaging) — You are listing what people have shared in a community feed or on a profile, with reactions,… **Page templates** (whole pages composed from the patterns above; start a new screen from the closest one): `explore-page`, `profile-page`, `pricing-page`, `landing-page`, `image-studio-page`, `video-studio-page`, `studio-home-page`, `asset-library-page`, `app-shell`, `app-shell-sidebar`, `settings-page`, `canvas-shell`. ## Tokens Every name below is a Tailwind color utility suffix: `bg-`, `text-`, `border-`, `ring-` (opacity works: `bg-brand/20`). - **Fill + text pairs** (put `text--foreground` on `bg-`): `card`, `popover`, `primary`, `secondary`, `accent`, `muted`, `destructive`, `brand`, `brand-tint`, `glass`, `soft`, `commerce-pink`, `commerce-blue`, `badge-new`, `badge-neutral`, `sale`, `tooltip`, `chip`, `kbd`, `tile-blue`, `tile-purple`, `tile-pink`, `tile-orange`, `tile-mint`, `tile-brown`, `success` - **Single roles:** `background`, `foreground`, `brand-text`, `glass-border`, `glass-hover`, `tooltip-border`, `listbox`, `listbox-border`, `glass-panel`, `glass-panel-light`, `separator`, `switch-off`, `field`, `chip-border`, `divider`, `skeleton`, `dialog`, `overlay`, `success-tint`, `chart-1`, `chart-2`, `chart-3`, `chart-4`, `chart-5`, `border`, `input`, `ring` - **Gradients** (use as `bg-[image:var(--)]`): `brand-gloss`, `badge-hot`, `badge-value`, `text-gold`, `text-fade`, `skeleton-shimmer` - **Meaning:** `background` page · `card`/`soft` raised panels · `glass` translucent controls (`glass-hover` on hover) · `field` inputs · `chip` composer chips · `dialog` modals · `overlay` scrims · `muted-foreground` secondary text · `brand` lime · `primary` white · `separator`/`divider` hairlines · `tile-*` icon-tile colors. - **Text styles:** `text-display-sm`, `text-display-md`, `text-display-lg`, `text-display-xl`, `text-label-caps`, `text-title-sm`, `text-title-md` (size, line height, weight and tracking in one class), plus `text-2xs`…`text-6xl`. Fonts: `font-sans`, `font-display`, `font-grotesk`, `font-mono`. - **Radius:** `rounded-xs`, `rounded-sm`, `rounded-md`, `rounded-lg`, `rounded-control`, `rounded-xl`, `rounded-2xl`, `rounded-3xl`, `rounded-4xl`, `rounded-full`. Controls use `rounded-control`. - **Shadows:** `shadow-popover`, `shadow-card-inset`, `shadow-thumb-on`, `shadow-thumb-lg`, `shadow-thumb-off`, `shadow-inset-glass`, `shadow-inset-tint`, `shadow-cta-light`, `shadow-cta-brand`, `shadow-cta-pink`, `shadow-cta-blue`, `shadow-gloss-edge`, `shadow-sm`, `shadow-md`, `shadow-lg`, `shadow-xl`. - **Motion:** `animate-shimmer`. Interactions dim on hover (`hover:brightness-80`) and press (`active:brightness-60`) over 200ms. ## Icons 115 icons are bundled; their names are the keys of `components/ui/icons.generated.ts` (common: `add`, `close`, `check`, `search`, `more_vert`, `download`, `share`, `settings`). `IconName` is a typed union, so an unknown name fails the typecheck. A missing icon needs a new Mantis release; ask the owner. ## Look things up - Per-component do/don't, accessibility and tokens: `https://mantisdesignsystem.com/usage/.md`. - Live examples of every component, pattern and page: - Registry search and install: the shadcn MCP server. `components.json` needs `"registries": { "@mantis": "https://mantisdesignsystem.com/r/{name}.json" }`; then run `npx shadcn@latest mcp init` once and search the `@mantis` namespace. - Visual intent and composition recipes: .
